name: DNS
summary: DNS turns names like nova-files01.nova.corp into addresses.
inNova: DNS for nova.corp runs on both domain controllers, DC01 (10.10.20.10) and DC02 (10.10.20.11), and NOVA-CLIENT is set to use both. The records that let a computer find a domain controller live there too. So when NOVA-CLIENT was pointed at a wrong DNS server, the IT share looked down even though FILES01 answered on port 445. That is the one case on this site where DNS was the whole problem.
